text:
Understand a shared checkout before updating or deploying it. Inspect changes and history, then synchronize or publish within configured access. Start with list and status; changes use this server's Git identity and each repository's access limit.
list: Find the repository names this instance is configured to use.
autopull <repo> [now]: Review the last automatic update result. Add now to request one update in the configured mode; running it requires the deploy role.
  now (bool): true to run one update; text form: autopull <repo> now
status <repo>: See the current branch, changed paths and untracked files in a repository.
log <repo> [lines]: Review recent commits in a repository.
  lines (int): 1..1000; default 20
rev <repo>: Identify the checked-out commit and branch. A checkout without a branch is reported as detached.
fetch <repo>: Refresh upstream history and see how many commits are ahead or behind.
diff <repo>: Review local change sizes and untracked paths before updating or committing.
[destructive] pull <repo> [rev] [file]: Update a checkout by fast-forward only. A revision selects a detached checkout; a revision and file restore only that file.; role: deploy|commit
  rev (string): Revision to check out
  file (string): Literal relative file path at that revision
[destructive] deploy <repo> [branch] [rev] [id]: Deploy a repository and review the result record. Fetch first, then use the current or configured branch, or a named branch with an optional reachable revision.; role: deploy|commit
  branch (string): Branch; a configured pin cannot be overridden
  rev (string): 7..40 lower-case hex, reachable from the origin branch
  id (string): Optional correlation id, 1..64 letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen (JSON form)
[destructive] reset <repo>: Discard local changes and reset to the configured branch's upstream.; role: deploy|commit
[destructive] clean <repo>: Delete untracked files and directories from the checkout.; role: deploy|commit
add <repo> <paths...>: Stage selected paths for a commit. Paths are literal and relative to the repository.; role: commit
  paths (list): Paths to stage; JSON array, text has one or more words
commit <repo> <message>: Save staged changes as a commit using this server's Git identity.; role: commit
  message (string): Commit message; quote it in text calls
[destructive] push <repo>: Publish commits using this server's identity and SSH key.; role: commit

Arguments
repo (string): Repository name declared in Configuration.repos

Examples
agent-bus call '#git@parf.us' 'list'
agent-bus call '#git@parf.us' 'autopull ab'
agent-bus call '#git@parf.us' 'status ab'
agent-bus call '#git@parf.us' 'log ab 5'
agent-bus call '#git@parf.us' 'rev ab'
agent-bus call '#git@parf.us' 'diff ab'
